sanskrit: gāyanti tvā gāyatriṇo 'rcantyarkamarkiṇaḥ . brahmāṇastvā śatakrata udvaṃśamiva yemire
english: The singers of the Gāyatrī sing of you; those who chant the Arka-hymns adore you. The Brahmin priests, O you of a hundred powers, have stretched you upward like a bamboo pole.

sanskrit: indraṃ viśvā avīvṛdhantsamudravyacasaṃ giraḥ . rathītamaṃ rathīnāṃ vājānāṃ satpatiṃ patim
english: All hymns have magnified Indra, ocean-wide in his expanse — the most chariot-worthy of charioteers, the true lord and master of prizes.

sanskrit: imamindra sutaṃ piba jyeṣṭhamamartyaṃ madam . śukrasya tvābhyakṣarandhārā ṛtasya sādane
english: Drink this, Indra — the pressed soma, the foremost, the immortal exhilaration. The bright streams of sacred order pour toward you in the seat of Rita.

sanskrit: yadindra citra ma iha nāsti tvādātamadrivaḥ . rādhastanno vidadvasa ubhayāhastyā bhara
english: What gift of wonders, O wielder of the stone-bolt, is not yet given by you here? Knowing our bounty, O wealthy one, bring it with both hands.

sanskrit: śrudī havaṃ tiraścyā indra yastvā saparyati . suvīryasya gomato rāyaspūrdhi mahāṃ asi
english: Hear the call from afar, O Indra, of him who worships you. Fill him with wealth of good heroes and of cattle — you are truly great.

sanskrit: asāvi soma indra te śaviṣṭha dhṛṣṇavā gahi . ā tvā pṛṇaktvindriyaṃ rajaḥ sūryo na raśmibhiḥ
english: The soma has been pressed for you, O mightiest Indra — come boldly! May the sovereign power fill you, as the sun fills the sky with its rays.

sanskrit: endra yāhi haribhirupa kaṇvasya suṣṭutim . divo amuṣya śāsato divaṃ yaya divāvaso
english: Come, O Indra, with your bay steeds, to the excellent praise of Kaṇva. Directed from yonder heaven, travel through the sky, O guardian of the day.

sanskrit: ā tvā giro rathīrivāsthuḥ suteṣu girvaṇaḥ . abhi tvā samanūṣata gāvo vatsaṃ na dhenavaḥ
english: Hymns have approached you like charioteers at the soma-pressings, O lover of song. They have lowed all around you as cows low about their calf.

sanskrit: eto nvindraṃ stavāma śuddhaṃ śuddhena sāmnā . śuddhairukthairvāvṛdhvāṃsaṃ śuddhairāśīrvānmamattu
english: Come now, let us praise Indra, the pure one, with a pure Sāman. May he, grown mighty with pure recitations, delight and be satisfied with pure blessings.

sanskrit: yo rayiṃ vo rayintamo yo dyumnairdyumnavattamaḥ . somaḥ sutaḥ sa indra te 'sti svadhāpate madaḥ
english: He who is richest in wealth among you, most glorious in brilliance — the pressed soma, O Indra, is your exhilaration, O lord of self-power.

sanskrit: araṅgamāya jagmaye 'paścādadhvane naraḥ
english: Men have come to the one prepared and ready, to the one who travels on a pathless way.

sanskrit: ā no vayovayaḥśayaṃ mahāntaṃ gahvareṣṭhāṃ mahāntaṃ pūrvineṣṭhām . ugraṃ vaco apāvadhīḥ
english: Bring to us the great one who rests among the birds, the great one who dwells in the cavern, the first and foremost. You have smitten away fierce speech.

sanskrit: ā tvā rathaṃ yathotaye sumnāya vartayāmasi . tuvikūrmimṛtīṣahamindraṃ śaviṣṭha satpatim
english: We turn your chariot as for help and for grace. O mightiest one, O true lord — Indra, the greatly active, the vanquisher of enemies.

sanskrit: sa pūrvyo mahonāṃ venaḥ kratubhirānaje . yasya dvārā manuḥ pitā deveṣu dhiya ānaje
english: He, the primal one, the longing of the great ones, has reached forth through his powers. Through whose doors Manu, the father, has reached forth his thoughts among the gods.

sanskrit: yadī vahantyāśavo bhrājamānā ratheṣvā . pibanto madiraṃ madhu tatra śravāṃsi kṛṇvate
english: When the swift ones, resplendent, are harnessed in the chariots — drinking the intoxicating sweetness — there they win renown.

sanskrit: tyamu vo aprahaṇaṃ gṛṇīṣe śavasaspatim . indraṃ viśvāsāhaṃ naraṃ śaciṣṭhaṃ viśvavedasam
english: That one I praise for you, the unassailable, the lord of might — Indra, the overcomer of all, the hero most powerful in deeds, the all-knowing.

sanskrit: dadhikrāvṇo akāriṣaṃ jiṣṇoraśvasya vājinaḥ . surabhi no mukhā karatpra na āyūṃṣi tāriṣat
english: I have spoken in praise of Dadhikrāvan, the victorious, the horse of might. May he make our mouths fragrant; may he extend our life-spans.

sanskrit: purāṃ bhinduryuvā kaviramitaujā ajāyata . indro viśvasya karmaṇo dharttā vajrī puruṣṭutaḥ
english: The breaker of strongholds was born young, a seer of unlimited might. Indra, the upholder of all action, the wielder of the thunderbolt, praised by many.

sanskrit: dhiyā vo medhasātaye purandhyā vivāsati
english: He seeks to win you by thought and by the rich fullness of mind, for the sake of the sacrifice.

sanskrit: kaśyapasya svarvido yāvāhuḥ sayujāviti . yayorviśvamapi vrataṃ yajñaṃ dhīrā nicāyya
english: The two who are called the yoked pair of Kaśyapa, the heaven-finders — whose universal ordinance and sacrifice the wise, having considered, observe.

sanskrit: arcata prārcatā naraḥ priyamedhāso arcata . arcantu putrakā uta puramiddhṛṣṇvarcata
english: Sing, sing forth, O men; sing, O you of dear wisdom. Let the young sons also sing; boldly sing the stronghold that shines.

sanskrit: ukthamindrāya śaṃsyaṃ vardhanaṃ puruniḥṣidhe . śakro yathā suteṣu no rāraṇatsakhyeṣu ca
english: The recitation to be proclaimed for Indra, that which increases, for the ever-besought one — so that the mighty one may rejoice among us at the soma-pressings and in companionship.

sanskrit: viśvānarasya vaspatimanānatasya śavasaḥ . evaiśca carṣaṇīnāmūtī huve rathānām
english: The lord of all men, the lord of the unyielding might — by these same paths, I call on the aid of the peoples and of the chariots.

sanskrit: sa ghā yaste divo naro dhiyā martasya śamataḥ . ūtī sa bṛhato divo dviṣo aṃho na tarati
english: He indeed who, O divine men, calms the mortal by thought — with such aid he crosses not the great heaven's enmity nor adversity.

sanskrit: vibhoṣṭa indra rādhaso vibhvī rātiḥ śatakrato . athā no viśvacarṣaṇe dyumnaṃ sudatra maṃhaya
english: Your bounty, O Indra, is all-pervading; your gift is wide-reaching, O you of a hundred powers. So now, O one visible to all peoples, O good giver, bestow on us brilliance.

sanskrit: vayaścitte patatriṇo dvipāccatuṣpādarjuni . uṣaḥ prārannṛtūṃranu divo antebhyaspari
english: The birds that are of your mind, the flying ones, two-footed and four-footed in the bright space — at dawn they have sprung forward following the seasons, from the ends of heaven.

sanskrit: amī ye devā sthana madhya ā rocane divaḥ . kadva ṛtaṃ kadamṛtaṃ kā pratnā va āhutiḥ
english: You gods who stand in the middle of the luminous realm of heaven — what is the sacred order for you? What is the immortal? What is your ancient oblation?

sanskrit: ṛcaṃ sāma yajāmahe yābhyāṃ karmāṇi kṛṇvate . vi te sadasi rājato yajñaṃ deveṣu vakṣataḥ
english: We worship the Ṛc and the Sāman, by means of which the ritual works are performed. The two that reign in their seat shall carry the sacrifice to the gods.

sanskrit: kratve vare sthemanyāmurīmutogramojiṣṭhaṃ tarasaṃ tarasvinam
english: In wisdom, in choice, in firm standing, in the liberal, the most fiercely mighty, the swift, the courageous.

sanskrit: śratte dadhāmi prathamāya manyave 'hanyaddasyuṃ naryaṃ viverapaḥ . ubhe yatvā rodasī dhāvatāmanu bhyasātte śuṣmātpṛthivī cidadrivaḥ
english: I place trust in his primary wrath, which smote the Dasyu and opened the manly waters. Both worlds ran after you; even the earth shrinks, O stone-bolt bearer, from your fury.

sanskrit: sameta viśvā ojasā patiṃ divo ya eka idbhūratithirjanānām sa pūrvyo nūtanamājigīṣaṃ taṃ varttanīranu vāvṛta eka it
english: Come together, all, to the lord of heaven in his might — he alone who has been the abundant host of peoples. He, the primal one, desiring to conquer the new, has turned the paths about him — he alone.

sanskrit: ime ta indra te vayaṃ puruṣṭuta ye tvārabhya carāmasi prabhūvaso . na hi tvadanyo girvaṇo giraḥ saghatkṣoṇīriva prati taddharya no vacaḥ
english: We are yours, O Indra, O much-praised, we who move about relying on you, O most abundant wealthy one. For no other than you, O lover of song, can hold our hymns together — like the earth, accept our speech toward that.

sanskrit: carṣaṇīdhṛtaṃ maghavānamukthyā3mindraṃ giro bṛhatīrabhyanūṣata . vāvṛdhānaṃ puruhūtaṃ suvṛktibhiramartyaṃ jaramāṇaṃ divedive
english: The great hymns, the mighty chants, have bellowed toward Indra, the magnanimous, the sustainer of the peoples, the invocation-worthy — grown great with pure praises, called by many, immortal, aging day by day.

sanskrit: acchā va indraṃ matayaḥ svaryuvaḥ sadhrīcīrviśvā uśatīranūṣata . pari ṣvajanta janayo yathā patiṃ maryaṃ na śundhyuṃ maghavānamūtaye
english: Toward Indra, all thoughts — heaven-seeking, unanimous, eager — have bellowed. They have embraced him all around as women embrace a husband, like a young hero, the magnanimous one, for aid.

sanskrit: abhi tyaṃ meṣaṃ puruhūtamṛgmiyamindraṃ gīrbhirmadatā vasvo arṇavam . yasya dyāvo na vicaranti mānuṣaṃ bhuje maṃhiṣṭhamabhi vipramarcata
english: With your hymns exhilarate that ram, Indra the much-invoked, the hymn-worthy, the ocean of riches. The heavens do not wander beyond his human understanding; sing to him, the most bountiful, the sage.

sanskrit: tyaṃ su meṣaṃ mahayā svarvidaṃ śataṃ yasya subhuvaḥ sākamīrate . atyaṃ na vājaṃ havanasyadaṃ rathamendraṃ vavṛtyāmavase suvṛktibhiḥ
english: Magnify well that ram, the heaven-finder, with whose hundred of good beings they move together. Like a swift horse toward the prize, toward the chariot that heeds the call — may we turn Indra to our aid with pure praises.

sanskrit: ghṛtavatī bhuvanānāmabhiśriyorvī pṛthvī madhudughe supeśasā . dyāvāpṛthivī varuṇasya dharmaṇā viṣkabhite ajare bhūriretasā
english: Full of ghee, of all worlds the splendor, wide and broad, the two honey-yielding, beautifully formed ones — Heaven and Earth, propped apart by the law of Varuṇa, ageless and rich in seed.

sanskrit: ubhe yadindra rodasī āpaprāthoṣā iva . mahāntaṃ tvā mahīnāṃ samrājaṃ carṣaṇīnām . devī janitryajījanadbhadrā janitryajījanat
english: When, O Indra, you filled both worlds as the dawns fill them — you, the great one, the sovereign king of the great ones and of peoples. The divine mother gave birth to him; the auspicious mother gave birth.

sanskrit: pra mandine pitumadarcatā vaco yaḥ kṛṣṇagarbhā nirahannṛjiśvanā . avasyavo vṛṣaṇaṃ vajradakṣiṇaṃ marutvantaṃ sakhyāya huvemahi
english: Recite the word rich in nourishment to the joyful one, who with his companion drove out the black-wombed one. Desiring aid, we call the bull, thunderbolt in his right hand, accompanied by Maruts, for fellowship.

sanskrit: vide vṛdhasya dakṣasya mahāṃ hi ṣaḥ
english: The growing, skilled one is known — for he is truly great.

sanskrit: tamu abhi pra gāyata puruhūtaṃ puruṣṭutam . indraṃ gīrbhistaviṣamā vivāsata
english: Sing forth toward him, the much-invoked, the much-praised. Seek to win mighty Indra with your hymns.

sanskrit: taṃ te madaṃ gṛṇīmasi vṛṣaṇaṃ pṛkṣu sāsahim . u lokakṛtnumadrivo hariśriyam
english: We sing of that your exhilaration, the bull, the conqueror in battles — and the world-maker, O stone-bolt bearer, glorious with bay steeds.

sanskrit: yatsomamindra viṣṇavi yadvā gha trita āptye . yadvā marutsu mandase samindubhiḥ
english: When, O Indra, you rejoice in the soma with Viṣṇu, or indeed with Trita Āptya, or when you delight among the Maruts together with the soma-drops.

sanskrit: edu madhormadintaraṃ siñcādhvaryo andhasaḥ . evā hi vīrastavate sadāvṛdhaḥ
english: Pour out more of the intoxicating sweetness from the plant-juice, O Adhvaryu. For thus the hero is praised — he who is ever-growing.

sanskrit: endumindrāya siñcata pibāti somyaṃ madhu . pra rādhāṃsi codayate mahitvanā
english: Pour the soma-drop for Indra — he drinks the soma sweetness. He urges on bounties with his greatness.

sanskrit: eto nvindraṃ stavāma sakhāyaḥ stomyaṃ naram . kṛṣṭīryo viśvā abhyastyeka it
english: Come now, friends, let us praise Indra, the hero worthy of hymns — he alone who surpasses all peoples.

sanskrit: indrāya sāma gāyata viprāya bṛhate bṛhat . brahmakṛte vipaścite panasyave
english: Sing the Sāman to Indra, the great to the great inspired one — to the maker of prayer, the wise, the praiseworthy.

sanskrit: ya eka idvidayate vasu martāya dāśuṣe . īśāno apratiṣkuta indro aṅga
english: He who alone knows how to bestow wealth on the mortal who gives — the ruling, unimpeded Indra, verily.

sanskrit: sakhāya ā śiṣāmahe brahmendrāya vajriṇe . stuṣa ū ṣu vo nṛtamāya dhṛṣṇave
english: Friends, let us learn the prayer for Indra the thunderbolt-bearer. I shall praise well the most heroic, the bold one among you.
